pack: GHL Fill-in-the-Blank Pack by SynCloud Connect

variables.BUSINESS_NAME: Your business name as customers know it
variables.FIRST_NAME: Leave as {{contact.first_name}} to let GoHighLevel fill it per contact
variables.SERVICE: What you do, in the customer's words (e.g. AC repair)
variables.DEADLINE: When the offer ends (e.g. Friday at 5pm)
variables.REVIEW_LINK: Direct link to your Google review form
variables.DAYS_SINCE: How long since the last visit (e.g. 6 months)

sms.name: Missed-call text back
sms.use: Fires within 1 minute of a missed call so the lead doesn't call the next business on the list.
sms.body: Hi, this is [OWNER_NAME] with [BUSINESS_NAME]. Sorry I missed your call! I'm on a job right now. What can I help you with? You can also grab a time here: [BOOKING_LINK]

sms.name: New lead: first touch
sms.use: Sent the moment a form or ad lead comes in.
sms.body: Hi [FIRST_NAME], [OWNER_NAME] from [BUSINESS_NAME] here. Got your request about [SERVICE]. Is now a good time for a quick call, or would you rather pick a time? [BOOKING_LINK]

sms.name: Appointment reminder
sms.use: 24 hours and 2 hours before the appointment.
sms.body: Hi [FIRST_NAME], quick reminder: [BUSINESS_NAME] is scheduled for [APPOINTMENT_TIME]. Reply C to confirm or R to reschedule.

sms.name: Review request
sms.use: 2 hours after a job is marked complete.
sms.body: Thanks for choosing [BUSINESS_NAME], [FIRST_NAME]! If we did a good job, would you mind leaving a quick review? It takes 30 seconds and helps a small business a lot: [REVIEW_LINK]

sms.name: Win-back / reactivation
sms.use: Customers with no visit in [DAYS_SINCE]. Acknowledge the gap; don't pitch hard.
sms.body: Hi [FIRST_NAME], it's [OWNER_NAME] at [BUSINESS_NAME]. It's been about [DAYS_SINCE] and I wanted to check in. If you need anything, we're holding [OFFER] for past customers until [DEADLINE]. Just reply here.

sms.name: Offer with a deadline
sms.use: Short promo blast to an opted-in list.
sms.body: [BUSINESS_NAME]: [OFFER] for [CITY] customers, ends [DEADLINE]. Book here: [BOOKING_LINK]. Reply STOP to opt out.

email.name: Welcome / what happens next
email.use: Right after a new lead or customer signs up.
email.subject: Welcome to [BUSINESS_NAME], [FIRST_NAME]
email.body:
Hi [FIRST_NAME],

Thanks for reaching out to [BUSINESS_NAME]. Here's what happens next:

1. We'll review what you need for [SERVICE].
2. You'll hear from me within one business day.
3. If you'd rather not wait, pick a time that works for you: [BOOKING_LINK]

Talk soon,
[OWNER_NAME]
[BUSINESS_NAME] | [PHONE]

email.name: Quote follow-up
email.use: 3 days after sending a quote with no reply.
email.subject: Any questions on your [SERVICE] quote?
email.body:
Hi [FIRST_NAME],

I wanted to make sure the quote for [SERVICE] came through and made sense. If anything's unclear or you'd like to adjust the scope, just reply and I'll sort it out.

If you're ready to go, you can lock in a date here: [BOOKING_LINK]

[OWNER_NAME]
[BUSINESS_NAME]

email.name: We miss you
email.use: Past customers with no activity in [DAYS_SINCE].
email.subject: [FIRST_NAME], it's been a while
email.body:
Hi [FIRST_NAME],

It's been about [DAYS_SINCE] since we last saw you at [BUSINESS_NAME], and I wanted to say thanks for being a customer.

If there's anything you need, we're offering [OFFER] to past customers through [DEADLINE].

Reply to this email or book here: [BOOKING_LINK]

[OWNER_NAME]

email.name: Review request (email)
email.use: Backup to the SMS review request, sent the next day if no review.
email.subject: How did we do, [FIRST_NAME]?
email.body:
Hi [FIRST_NAME],

Thanks again for trusting [BUSINESS_NAME] with your [SERVICE]. If you have 30 seconds, a review helps other people in [CITY] find us:

[REVIEW_LINK]

If anything wasn't right, reply here and I'll make it right.

[OWNER_NAME]

workflows.name: Missed-call text back (GHL workflow blueprint)
steps: Trigger: Call Status = missed / no answer (inbound).
Wait: 1 minute.
Action: Send SMS using 'sms-missed-call-text-back'.
Condition: Contact replied within 30 minutes? If yes: notify [OWNER_NAME] and stop.
If no: Wait 1 day, send 'sms-speed-to-lead'.
Action: Add tag 'missed-call'; create opportunity in pipeline stage 'New Lead'.

workflows.name: New lead nurture (GHL workflow blueprint)
workflows.use: For form, ad and imported leads tagged by the Data Prep Kit.
steps: Trigger: Contact Tag added = your import tag (set with --tags in the Data Prep Kit).
Action: Send 'sms-speed-to-lead' immediately (business hours only).
Action: Send 'email-welcome'.
Wait: 2 days. If no booking: send 'email-quote-follow-up' or a second SMS.
Wait: 5 days. If still no reply: add tag 'cold' and move to the long-term nurture list.
Goal: Appointment booked > remove from workflow.

workflows.name: Review engine (GHL workflow blueprint)
workflows.use: Turns every completed job into a review request.
steps: Trigger: Opportunity moved to 'Won' or appointment status 'Showed'.
Wait: 2 hours.
Action: Send 'sms-review-request'.
Wait: 1 day. Condition: review left? If no: send 'email-review-request'.
Action: Add tag 'review-asked' so nobody gets asked twice.

workflows.name: Reactivation campaign (GHL workflow blueprint)
workflows.use: Run monthly on customers with no activity in [DAYS_SINCE].
steps: Trigger: Smart list of customers with last appointment older than [DAYS_SINCE] (or import that list with tag 'reactivate').
Action: Send 'sms-reactivation'.
Wait: 3 days. If no reply: send 'email-reactivation'.
Condition: replied or booked? Notify [OWNER_NAME] and remove tag 'reactivate'.
If no response after 14 days: add tag 'dormant' and stop.
